PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: fx-gate-fragments
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Atmosphere/VFX guard: transfer only light falloff, particle behavior, haze density, ember/gold color relationships, and cinematic exposure. Keep the effect content and compositing requirements controlled by this row.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
FX-GATE-FRAGMENTS — PRODUCTION REFERENCE: CINEMATIC VFX, PARTICLES, LIGHT, TRANSFORMATION, AND MOTION REFERENCE.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Cinematic VFX action still of Hell's Gate mid-shatter: the colossal 100-foot iron-and-bone fortress entrance exploding outward in a violent radial storm of molten fragments at the instant after Christ speaks Open. Freeze-frame peak destruction—not an intact door, not settled rubble, but debris still in flight, hung in air by the camera as if time itself recoiled.

Material continuity locks hard to the gate canon. Every shard is a fusion of blackened corroded iron and pale fused bone: jagged iron plates with rust blooms, pitted scale, and dried-blood encrustation; bone ribs, vertebrae, and skull-plate sections locked into the metal like structural rebar, fractured clean through so marrow cavities and porous ivory edges show. Fragments range from house-sized gate slabs down to fist-sized shrapnel and glittering iron grit. Several large pieces still carry partial carved faces of the damned mid-scream, expressions frozen as the sculpture tears free—one face only on each carved surface, never a rear face on any head form.

Inner fracture edges glow with divine fire from the power that broke them: molten orange-gold seams along crack lines, white-hot hairline fractures, and soft radiant heat-haze warping air around the largest slabs. Not industrial furnace light—sacred intrusion burning through hell-forged metal. Sparks, micro-droplets of liquid iron, and bone dust form a dense particle cloud, streaking outward on ballistic arcs from the former gate plane. Corroded bronze fittings, hinge bosses, and chain-link remnants tumble with the main mass, spinning end over end.

Environment: the fortress gate threshold in Hell's cathedral of suffering—black stone pillars and floor visible through the growing breach, residual cold blue torch light (~2000K) washing side walls while the explosion's key light is pure golden-white divine radiance (~6500K) blasting through the opening from Christ-side space, volumetrics cutting god rays through ash and smoke. Deep crimson underglow and obsidian blacks remain in the periphery; center of frame is triumph of gold over iron. Thick atmospheric smoke and ash are shoved outward in shockwave rings; heat shimmer and particulate glitter read in side light.

Composition is dramatic freeze-frame action at 2.39:1 cinematic widescreen: wide-to-medium heroic VFX plate, low three-quarter angle looking slightly upward so the largest fragments dominate the sky of the frame and convey 100-foot scale. Approximate 35mm anamorphic epic feel, deep enough focus to hold near-field shrapnel and mid-field gate slabs, with distant fortress architecture soft in smoke. Motion-blur streaks only on the fastest small debris; hero fragments read sharp and readable for production reference.

Color grade: deep crimsons and obsidian blacks in the hell architecture, cold royal-blue torch spill at the edges, ethereal gold and pure white core light through the breach, molten amber-orange on fracture interiors. Photoreal live-action biblical epic—physically coherent metal fracture, bone grain, and particle behavior, not cartoon CGI, not illustration, not fantasy game VFX. Sacred tone of absolute triumph over darkness: the prison door of death failing under divine authority.

Continuity: iron-plus-bone gate materials only; blue hell torches still present in background until full transformation later; no modern objects, no machinery, no logos, no readable text, captions, watermarks, borders, or UI. No human hero figure required in this plate—focus is pure gate-fragment action effect usable as FX and atmosphere reference for the SEQ-07 gate-shatters beat when iron explodes outward in a storm of molten fragments and light floods the fortress.
